description: This Java source file defines the OrbitalPaymentServices class, which provides methods for processing various credit card transactions (authorization, capture, refund, release) via the Orbital SDK, including building requests, processing responses, and managing transaction processing.

classes.name: OrbitalPaymentServices
classes.description: A utility class providing methods for processing credit card transactions through the Orbital SDK, including authorization, capture, refund, and release operations, along with request building and response handling.

methods.name: ccRefund

methods.name: ccRelease
methods.description: Reverses or releases a previously authorized transaction.
